subject: Qualification recap: procurement path, paperflow options & SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@novaterra.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Qualification recap: procurement path, paperflow options & SOC 2 evidence

Hi Elena — great to speak today, thanks for the intro to the team and context on your evaluation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the procurement path: 

Call summary (high level)
- Use case: LLM inference for customer support triage + embeddings for KB search; pilot expected ~250k tokens / month.
- Primary constraint: procurement must validate SOC 2 + signed DPA before production.
- Procurement preference: appear to favor PO for enterprise purchases but open to Marketplace for a quick pilot.

Questions / asks for Novaterra
1) Procurement contact: can you loop in the person who manages paperflow so we can clarify PO timelines and invoicing cadence?
2) Preferred purchase: PO (standard SOW/invoice) vs corporate card/marketplace for a 30-day pilot? If PO, what is the expected approval lead time (estimate in business days)?
3) Security gating: procurement asked for SOC 2 attestation and DPA counterparty. They also typically run a short security questionnaire. Can you share the questionnaire or vendor intake form?

What I attached
- SOC2_summary_v3.pdf — short summary + audit date and scope.
- Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx — proposed timeline/owners for pilot → procurement → production.

Proposed next steps
- If PO required: share procurement contact and target approval date; we’ll plan to get DPA ready for redline and confirm evidence.
- If Marketplace preferred: we can spin up a short paid pilot immediately (card) while procurement completes PO/DPA.
- Schedule: I’m available Thurs 12/10 10:00–12:00 PT to walk procurement through what evidence we have.

Thanks — I’ll await the procurement contact and the vendor questionnaire if possible.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: SOC2_summary_v3.pdf (summary), Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (M.A.P.)
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@novaterra.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novaterra.com
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Qualification recap: procurement path, paperflow options & SOC 2 evidence

Thanks Ben — good recap. Looping in procurement (procurement@novaterra.com) so we can be explicit on requirements. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- Procurement preference: For anything going into production we prefer a PO with net-30 terms. For initial pilots under $5k, our platform team will often use the corporate marketplace (fast) to avoid blocking the pilot.
- Timeline: If we go PO, typical legal + procurement lead time is 3–4 weeks (depends on DPA redline complexity).
- Security evidence: Procurement needs SOC 2 Type II (summary attestation + scope) and a completed vendor security questionnaire. I don’t have the questionnaire in this thread — attaching procurement@novaterra.com’s intake link separately.

procurement@novaterra.com: we’ll need:
1) Confirmation SOC 2 date/scope (is it infra + data processing for inference workloads?)
2) A redlineable DPA — we can provide our standard DPA for initial review.
3) Answers to our security questionnaire (I’ll send the link in a separate email).

Ben — can you confirm whether Redwood can provide SOC 2 attestation and whether legal can turn around a DPA redline within ~7 business days? That will determine whether we push for marketplace pilot vs wait for PO.

Appreciate it — Elena
VP Product, Novaterra Systems
elena.ramos@novaterra.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Qualification recap: procurement path, paperflow options & SOC 2 evidence — procurement questions

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Novaterra’s reply and procurement CC. They need: SOC 2 attestation scope, a redlineable DPA, and answers to a security questionnaire. Can legal/ security help with the following?

1) Marissa — can you confirm which SOC 2 report we can share in full vs summary (we attached the summary — do we have an engagement letter + attestation PDF ready)?
2) Karthik — if procurement asks for a 7-business-day DPA turnaround, can legal prioritize a redline? If not, what is a realistic SLA?
3) Also, any objections to recommending a marketplace-paid pilot for the first 30 days to de-risk delivery while PO completes?

Procurement timeline from Elena is ~3–4 weeks for PO (typical). If we can do a swift DPA turnaround (7 business days) + SOC2 evidence, we should be fine. If not, recommend pitching marketplace pilot to get metrics quickly.

I’ve flagged this as high priority on the MAP and attached the Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx with owner columns filled for next steps.

Thanks — Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@novaterra.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Qualification recap: procurement path, paperflow options & SOC 2 evidence

Hi all — quick update from legal & security so we can keep momentum: 

1) SOC 2: Confirmed. We have a current SOC 2 Type II attestation covering our inference service and data processing controls. I am attaching SOC2_summary_v3.pdf here and can provide the auditor attestation (PDF) to procurement under an NDA if needed.
2) DPA: I attached DPA_redline_draft.docx — it contains our standard DPA with a few negotiation points highlighted. Legal can target an initial redline back within 7 business days if procurement provides their DPA or marks up ours. If Novaterra insists on their template, add 2–3 days.
3) Security questionnaire: we have a templated questionnaire response deck for procurement questionnaires (usually 10–15 pages) — Marissa to share the prefilled version within 48 hours once Elena sends the questionnaire.
4) Recommendation on payment path: to avoid blocking product validation, propose: a 30-day paid pilot via Marketplace (card) to start ingesting data and collecting metrics, while procurement workflows the PO/DPA for production. That reduces time-to-value and limits risk for Novaterra.

Next steps / owners: 
- Elena / Novaterra procurement: send vendor intake/security questionnaire (owner: Novaterra).
- Ben: confirm marketplace pilot sizing and quote for a 30-day pilot (owner: Ben).
- Marissa: provide SOC2 attestation PDF under NDA and share prefilled questionnaire in 48h (owner: Marissa).
- Karthik / Legal: stand by to prioritize DPA redline (owner: Karthik).

I’m available to join a procurement call Thurs 12/10 at 10:00 PT (Ben — you suggested that slot). If that works for Novaterra, I’ll accept the invite.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: DPA_redline_draft.docx, SOC2_summary_v3.pdf
